Subject: Finlytics — Eval kickoff and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed plan to kick off the evaluation: 

Recap
- Primary goal: reduce latency and cost of Finlytics' user-facing summarization pipeline while preserving summary quality (target: <200ms p50, match current ROUGE/qual tests).
- Top constraints: PII redaction requirements, VPC-only deployment for prod, and a 3-week proof-of-concept window.

Proposed evaluation kickoff agenda (60–75 min)
1) Introductions & success criteria alignment (10 min)
2) Trial plan & timeline (15 min) — reserved capacity vs hosted, data handling, metrics to track
3) Prompt set / eval design (15 min) — sample prompts, metrics, pass/fail thresholds
4) Technical deep dive (20–25 min) — networking, VPC peering, model selection, quantization options

Ask: can you share who will join from Finlytics (product, infra, legal if needed) and your availability next week? We can run the kickoff as a joint product+technical session — Connor (me) for product/plan, Marissa for eval design, and Neha for the infra/VPC details.  

I attached a short eval plan draft for reference (finlytics-eval-plan.pdf). If you prefer a different structure, happy to adapt.

Proposed times (PST) next week:
- Tue 2027-04-13 09:00–10:15
- Wed 2027-04-14 10:00–11:15
- Thu 2027-04-15 13:00–14:15

Looking forward —
Connor Obrien
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: finlytics-eval-plan.pdf (3 pages; outline of trial plan, success criteria, sample prompt set)
